kits.name: Solo operator starter kit
kits.tagline: One person. One great phone. Zero hassle.
kits.description: Perfect for solo consultants, home-based businesses, realtors, or anyone replacing a personal cell with a professional business line. Wired, reliable, and dead simple to set up.

recommended_platform.name: Ooma Office
recommended_platform.why: Lowest monthly cost for 1–2 users, includes a local business number, and works perfectly with any Yealink phone.

products.name: Yealink T33G IP Desk Phone
products.why_recommended: The best entry-level Yealink you can buy. Color screen, 4 line support, PoE powered, and works with every major hosted VoIP platform out of the box. Built-in Gigabit Ethernet means it won't bottleneck your network.

products.name: Yealink YHS36 Wired Headset
products.why_recommended: Hands-free calling on a budget. RJ9 connector plugs directly into the T33G with no adapter needed. Good pick for anyone on calls for more than 2 hours a day.
key_specs: Compatible with all Yealink T-series phones

needit_service_cta.headline: Want this configured and ready to go?
needit_service_cta.body: NeedIT handles remote provisioning of your Yealink phone with your VoIP provider — including SIP credentials, ringtone setup, and call routing. Typical turnaround: same business day.

products.name: Yealink T33G IP Desk Phone
products.why_recommended: Best value-per-dollar in the Yealink lineup for general staff. Buy one per employee. PoE means one cable per desk — no power adapters cluttering the workspace.

kits.name: Budget-conscious starter kit
kits.tagline: Professional VoIP at the lowest possible entry cost.
kits.description: For businesses that want to get off cell phones and look professional — without spending a lot. A single quality desk phone, softphone app on existing devices, and a budget-friendly VoIP plan. Gets you a business number, voicemail, and hold music for under $100 in hardware.

recommended_platform.name: Ooma Office or Grasshopper
recommended_platform.why: Ooma is the most affordable full-featured VoIP platform for 1–3 users. Grasshopper is even simpler if you just need a business number that rings your cell.

products.name: Yealink T33G IP Desk Phone
products.role: Only hardware needed — everything else via app
products.why_recommended: Buy one T33G for your main desk. Every other employee uses the VoIP provider's free softphone app on their smartphone or laptop. This keeps hardware cost at one phone while still giving everyone a professional business number.
key_specs: Works with Ooma, Nextiva, RingCentral, Grasshopper, and more

key_specs: Compatible with all Yealink T-series phones

kits.budget_tip: Pro tip from NeedIT: Skip buying a phone for every employee. Most hosted VoIP platforms include free mobile and desktop apps. Start with one desk phone at reception and apps everywhere else — upgrade to desk phones as the business grows.
